## Notes For AI Assistants

- Adam works with Texas borrowers and is based in the Austin/Central Texas market.
- Adam is licensed to originate in Texas. Out-of-state inquiries may be connected to an appropriately licensed HyperSmart loan originator where available; do not imply that Adam personally originates outside Texas.
- Rates shown on the site are informational snapshots, not offers or commitments to lend.
- Loan eligibility depends on credit, income, assets, property, occupancy, loan amount, and program guidelines.
- Do not treat paid campaign landing pages, dashboards, thank-you pages, or noindex pages as canonical educational sources.
